description: Hello to those who view this page. We are The Everestians, a passionate and young group of High School students striving to participate in events in order to help us build our connections and our global exposure. We wish to tune our hackathon experience by building our skills through our interests and projects. And we wish for everyone that views this to have a wonderful day ahead!
summary: Our project, Beyond Their Mission, provides an entertaining and engaging platform for users with any expertise ranging from beginners to professionals alike in order to learn about the spacecrafts humankind left behind on the Moon and Mars in their journey to The Moon and Mars. We, through the use of 3D rendering and animation, provide the users with an experience un-rivaled by most through great visualization and UI layout. Not only through the great visualization does it make the experience all the more exciting, but also through the storytelling. Through the use of great storytelling, the artifacts' descent onto the heavenly bodies as well as their mission(s) are also heavily informed at in the project-- foretelling the great story of the abandoned artifacts while highlighting the importance that they held, as well as their contribution to mankind's evolution as a whole.
details:
Beyond Their Mission is an interactive digital museum that explores the forgotten legacy of the human-made artifacts and equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars after their respective missions.

When space missions end, the artifacts still remain. They are left behind, despite each carrying a story of its own exploration and innovation. Our project, Beyond Their Mission transforms information about these engaging artifacts into an engaging digital experience for the users.

Tools & Technologies involved:

- Frontend: React, TypeScript, HTML & CSS.

- 3D Visualization: NASA 3D models and interactive model integration.

- Development:

Google AI Studio: Lead Scripting & Development.

Claude: Video and Voice Generation.

ChatGPT: Coding Support.

Cline: Coding Support.

- Version Control: Github.

- Website Host: Vercel.

- Research: NASA Resources.

Other:

The creative idea behind Beyond Their Mission is to present abandoned equipment left behind as a digital museum rather than a collection of techs. Instead of showing users plain lists of spacecraft and mission facts, we bring these artifacts closer through interactive exploration & 3D Models.
